children: Kura Oncology’s revenue rose year over year as U.S. KOMZIFTI sales more than offset lower collaboration revenue. Net loss narrowed, helped by lower research and development and selling, general and administrative expenses; other income declined, primarily due to lower interest income.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net Loss”. ³ Reported as “Net loss per share, basic and diluted”.
: U.S. product revenue was $13.9M; the company reported $28.8M in net product revenue for the first nine months of 2026.
: Parity coverage for KOMZIFTI was secured for more than 95% of covered U.S. lives.
: Patients have been dosed in both Phase 3 trials, and enrollment continues to progress.
: KO-7246 preclinical studies showed β-cell regeneration, durable glycemic control and increased endogenous insulin production.
